parameters.query:
select p.id, p.workspace_id, p.external_post_id,
       cv.body, cv.title, cv.hashtags,
       ch.external_channel_id,
       ic.secret_ref
  from public.publications p
  join public.content_variants cv on cv.id = p.content_variant_id
  join public.channels ch on ch.id = p.channel_id
  left join public.integration_connections ic on ic.channel_id = ch.id
 where p.id = $1::uuid
   and p.status in ('queued','processing')
 for update of p skip locked;

update public.publications
   set status='published', external_post_id=$2, external_url=$3,
       published_at=now(), last_attempt_at=now(), attempt_count=attempt_count+1,
       locked_at=null, locked_by=null, updated_at=now()
 where id=$1::uuid
 returning id, workspace_id;

insert into public.automation_jobs (workspace_id, job_type, entity_type, entity_id, idempotency_key, run_after, payload)
select p.workspace_id, 'collect_post_metrics', 'publication', p.id,
       'snapshot:' || p.id || ':' || bucket.b,
       p.published_at + bucket.iv,
       jsonb_build_object('age_bucket', bucket.b, 'platform', 'vk')
  from public.publications p,
       (values ('1h', interval '1 hour'), ('6h', interval '6 hours'), ('24h', interval '24 hours'),
               ('72h', interval '72 hours'), ('7d', interval '7 days'), ('30d', interval '30 days')) as bucket(b, iv)
 where p.id = $1::uuid
on conflict (idempotency_key) do nothing;
